Evidence: Unannounced lawsuit, economic pushback
#Aletheia #Business

Proponents argue joining the lawsuit safeguards market competition and consumer welfare against media consolidation.

Resulting Judgement: (-0.4, -0.3) — Lesser Evil

Legal posturing by state regulators clashed directly with local economic interests, revealing uncoordinated governance.

- Jennifer Davenport: FAIL (-0.5, -0.4) — Acts without executive coordination.

The Bright Side:
Intense scrutiny on mega-mergers keeps corporate giants accountable to antitrust standards.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing legal grandstanding (HOW) with tangible economic stewardship (WHAT).

Regulators run a top-down bureaucratic maneuver, prioritizing abstract legal alignment over transparent economic collaboration with state stakeholders.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Bureaucratic silos override coherent public policy.

The Unavoidable Truth: State AGs have independent authority to litigate antitrust matters, but blindsiding local economic partners damages state trust.

The Unavoidable Lie: This litigation was smoothly coordinated across all levels of state leadership.
